Presets.Name: Juno octave bass
Presets.About: A Juno-60's saw and square an octave down, its filter snapping shut: the Italo octave bass.

Presets.Name: Bright Juno bass
Presets.About: The octave bass opened up: more resonance and a longer sweep, so every note bites and rings.

Presets.Name: Hi-NRG roller
Presets.About: A short, punchy saw for rolling 16th octaves, as Bobby Orlando's records drive.

Presets.Name: Bright roller
Presets.About: The Hi-NRG roller brighter and buzzier: a pulse in place of the square, the filter wide open on each note.

Presets.Name: Moog bass
Presets.About: Three saws through a ladder filter, round and heavy, as a Minimoog's.

Presets.Name: Acid line
Presets.About: A TB-303: a saw through a screaming filter, sliding only into tied notes, its accents stacking. Accent notes of velocity 1, the rest under.

Presets.Name: Industrial buzz bass
Presets.About: Two saws and a square an octave down, buzzing: set its track's Distort to fold and cut under 140 Hz, with a sub under it.

Presets.Name: EBM bass
Presets.About: A saw and a square an octave down, plucked short for 16ths whose offbeats you accent: the throb under futurepop.

Presets.Name: FM slap bass
Presets.About: A DX7's bass: an FM tone with a bright slap on its attack.

Presets.Name: Sub bass
Presets.About: A pure, deep sine and a touch of its octave, felt more than heard.

Presets.Name: Plucked bass
Presets.About: A string plucked, as Karplus and Strong pluck one: a dry, woody bass.

Presets.Name: Jupiter brass lead
Presets.About: Three detuned saws over two an octave down: a big polysynth hook, as a Jupiter-8's.

Presets.Name: Sync lead
Presets.About: A saw hard-synced to another, its tone tearing as it bends: a Prophet-5's scream.

Presets.Name: Square lead
Presets.About: A hollow square with a little vibrato, as a Mono/Poly sings a tune.

Presets.Name: Supersaw lead
Presets.About: Seven saws spread wide: a lead the size of a wall.

Presets.Name: Siren stab
Presets.About: A short, bright stab that scoops up into its note, for a techno hook.

Presets.Name: Power chord guitar
Presets.About: Saws to chug power chords with, c0, c2 and c0': set its track's Distort to amp, or fuzz, and pan two of them hard apart.

Presets.Name: Chip lead
Presets.About: A NES pulse, its level stepped: a game's tune.

Presets.Name: Juno pulse arp
Presets.About: A thin pulse with a snapping filter, for 16th arpeggios under a Juno's chorus.

Presets.Name: Bright saw arp
Presets.About: Two saws and a resonant snap: an arpeggio that cuts through a full mix.

Presets.Name: Resonant blip
Presets.About: A square through a filter on the edge of whistling, short as a drop: Moroder's sequencer.

Presets.Name: Futurepop arp
Presets.About: Three detuned saws and an octave, plucked: a trance arpeggio for 16ths, through a dotted-eighth delay.

Presets.Name: Glass FM arp
Presets.About: A bright FM tine, glassy and quick, as a DX7 sequenced.

Presets.Name: Octave pluck
Presets.About: A saw and its octave, plucked short: an arpeggio with sparkle on top.

Presets.Name: Harp pluck
Presets.About: A bright plucked string, as a harp's or a guitar's.

Presets.Name: Slither pulse
Presets.About: A thin pulse whose width sways, plucked short: a techno line that slithers.

Presets.Name: Fuzz strum guitar
Presets.About: A bright plucked string to strum chords on: give its track a Strum, a hall Wash and Distort to bury its reverb in fuzz, as noise pop does.

Presets.Name: Surf twang
Presets.About: A plucked string with a tremolo's wobble: give its track a spring Wash for a surf or spaghetti-western lead.

Presets.Name: Chip arp
Presets.About: A Commodore 64's chord on one voice, its notes stepping 50 times a second.

Presets.Name: OB brass
Presets.About: Detuned saws swelling open, as an Oberheim's brass section.

Presets.Name: Brass swell
Presets.About: Slow, rising brass for long chords that bloom.

Presets.Name: Orchestra hit
Presets.About: A chord of saws and noise, struck and gone: a Fairlight's ORCH5. Crush it to 8 bits on its track.

Presets.Name: Chord stab
Presets.About: A short, bright chord stab, as a club record's.

Presets.Name: DX7 E-piano
Presets.About: The 1980s' electric piano: an FM body and a bright 14:1 tine.

Presets.Name: Tubular bells
Presets.About: An inharmonic FM bell that rings for seconds.

Presets.Name: Glockenspiel
Presets.About: A small, high FM bell, struck.

Presets.Name: Tape piano
Presets.About: A quiet, detuned piano wobbling as worn tape does, for a sparse motif in a long room.

Presets.Name: Drawbar organ
Presets.About: Sines at the drawbars' footages, a rotary's wobble on them.

Presets.Name: String machine
Presets.About: Saws through a string machine's ensemble: set the track's chorus to ensemble.

Presets.Name: Juno pad
Presets.About: A warm saw and pulse pad, its filter breathing slowly, under a Juno's chorus.

Presets.Name: Gated supersaw
Presets.About: Seven saws and three an octave up, held: give its track a Gate, as x.xx x.x. x.xx x.x., and it chops as a trance pad.

Presets.Name: Glass pad
Presets.About: A bright, glassy pad of FM and saws, as a PPG Wave's.

Presets.Name: Supersaw pad
Presets.About: Five saws spread wide and a sine on top, slow and big.

Presets.Name: Aah choir
Presets.About: Saws singing an aah, a choir of machines.

Presets.Name: Baritone singer
Presets.About: A voice's buzz through a baritone's five formants, its vibrato coming in late: a clean, low lead to sing vowels with.

Presets.Name: Tenor singer
Presets.About: A tenor's voice, brighter and higher, its vibrato a little quicker.

Presets.Name: Sung choir
Presets.About: Voices and saws singing an alto's aah together, slow to swell: a choir for chords.

Presets.Name: Robot girl
Presets.About: An alto's voice with no vibrato and no glide, as a computer speaks: crush its track to 8 bits and coarse it 2.

Presets.Name: Vocoder voice
Presets.About: A rich carrier through a VP-330's ten bands: give its track vowels and it speaks.

Presets.Name: Robot baritone
Presets.About: A deep, half-spoken vocoder, for verses low in the voice, as Fancy sings.

Presets.Name: Whisper
Presets.About: The vocoder fed only noise: a voice that whispers its vowels, its notes only its rhythm.

Presets.Name: Scream
Presets.About: A raw vocoder of saws and noise, drifting: set its track's Distort to amp and it screams.

Presets.Name: Deadpan voice
Presets.About: A low, flat vocoder for talking a slogan, doubled by a Juno's chorus.

Presets.Name: Vocoder choir
Presets.About: Chords through the vocoder: a choir of robots for chants and pads.

Presets.Name: Laser zap
Presets.About: A pulse diving four octaves in a fifth of a second: pew.

Presets.Name: Phone bell
Presets.About: A telephone's bell, trilled 20 times a second: hold a note to ring it.

Presets.Name: Wind sweep
Presets.About: Noise through a resonant filter swept by a slow LFO: a whoosh to hold under a build.

Presets.Name: Machine drone
Presets.About: Noise through a low, resonant bandpass, chopped seven times a second: a machine turning in another room.

Presets.Name: Fuzz buzz
Presets.About: Saws and noise held as a drone: play it in tied 16ths and sweep its cutoff, its track's Distort turned up.

Presets.Name: Theremin
Presets.About: A nearly pure tone sliding from note to note under a wide vibrato, as a 1950s film's.

Presets.Name: TR-808
Presets.About: Roland's TR-808 as made in code: a long, booming kick, snappy snare, claps and metallic hats.

Presets.Name: Linn style
Presets.About: A tight, punchy kit, as a LinnDrum's: a short kick, a bright snare and crisp hats.

Presets.Name: Hi-NRG kit
Presets.About: Punchy kick, claps on the snare, cowbell and Simmons toms, as 1984's dance floors had them.

Presets.Name: Simmons kit
Presets.About: Electronic toms that dive, a snappy snare and a hard kick, as a Simmons SDS-V's.

Presets.Name: TR-909 techno
Presets.About: A 909's kick falling fast with its click, an 808 snare and rim, crisp hats and a dark ride: play bd9.

Presets.Name: Industrial kit
Presets.About: A heavy kick and snare, gritty hats and struck metal, mtl: crush, distort, ring and smash them on their tracks.

Presets.Name: Noise pop kit
Presets.About: No hi-hats: a big kick, a roomy snare, a floor tom to pulse eighths on and a tambourine, tamb, as the Raveonettes' records keep time.

Presets.Name: Commodore 64 kit
Presets.About: A SID chip's drums, built a frame at a time: play sbd, ssn, shh and the like.

Presets.Name: NES kit
Presets.About: The NES's drums, 60 frames a second: play nbd, nsn, nhh and the like.
